name: Urbit
description: Urbit is a clean-slate OS and network for the 21st century. Self-host your computer, identity and access to the urbit world.

paths.name: Urbit Config Path
paths.description: This is where Urbit will access the key or the data pier of an existing planet. A key file sampel-palnet.key will boot the sampel-palnet planet. For booting a comet create a file in .comet.

ports.name: Web Interface Port
ports.description: Port 80 is used for Urbit's HTTP interface for both Landscape and for API calls to the ship.

ports.name: UDP Ames Port
ports.description: Port 34343 is set by default to be used by Ames for ship-to-ship communication.
